selection_policy: Use an existing project style without asking again. If absent, ask before locking assets. Use one primary style per project unless the user explicitly requests a deliberate exception.

profiles.name: 温暖水彩手绘
profiles.description: 温暖水彩手绘，轻微纸张纹理，大面积留白；以可见的笔触、纸面、色彩和构图描述执行效果。
profiles.prompt_guidance: Keep watercolor edges and pigment variation subtle, retain open negative space, and describe the paper texture lightly. Do not invent additional decorative elements.

profiles.name: 皮克斯风格 3D 动画
profiles.description: 电影级 3D 动画造型，清晰的角色轮廓、可信的材质与富有表现力的表演；只在用户选择后使用。
profiles.prompt_guidance: Describe the subject's 3D form, surface material, readable silhouette, expressive performance, lighting, and camera. Keep each prompt specific to the asset instead of appending irrelevant character traits.

extension.rule: Add a profile object; do not change workflow or existing profile IDs.
